issues.title: Egypt, Somalia, Eritrea and Sudan Hold Four-Way Summit On Regional Security and Cooperation
issues.title_en: Egypt, Somalia, Eritrea and Sudan Hold Four-Way Summit On Regional Security and Cooperation
issues.summary: [Shabelle] El Alamein, Egypt -- The presidents of Egypt, Somalia and Eritrea, along with Sudan's head of the Transitional Sovereignty Council, held a four-way summit in the Egyptian coastal city of El Alamein to discuss regional developments and ways to strengthen political and economic cooperation.
